evidence_items.publisher: High Court of England and Wales (via BAILII), [2025] EWHC 2863 (Ch)

receipt.public_excerpt: it has admitted that "at least some" Copyright Works were used in training v2.0, that at least some images from the Getty Images Websites were used during training

evidence_items.explanation: Stability AI admitted in court that Getty's copyright works were used to train Stable Diffusion v2.0, v1.4 and the SD XL models. All of these were released before the post. This shows a popular image generator was trained on copyrighted images.

receipt.public_excerpt: It is common ground that all versions of Stable Diffusion were trained using various subsets of the LAION-5B dataset

evidence_items.explanation: Confirms that Stable Diffusion was trained on the web-scraped LAION-5B dataset. That is the dataset through which the admitted copyright works entered training.
